title: Auto mode becomes default for new sessions
description: Auto mode is now the default permission mode for new sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans, streamlining the workflow by reducing manual approval prompts.

title: VS Code Focus view and subagent forking default
description: VS Code extension receives new Focus view for better workspace management. Major subagent forking is now enabled by default, improving task distribution and parallel processing capabilities.

title: Security fixes and credential masking
description: Critical security fixes including Windows NTLM credential-leak closure, Bash permission bypass hardening, and sandbox credential masking. MCP v2 connection improvements and PowerShell/Cygwin permission fixes.

title: Cross-session SendMessage and GitLab integration
description: SendMessage tool now supports cross-machine communication. GitLab integration enhanced with merge request URL support and token redaction. Remote Control reconnection resilience improved.

title: Cross-session messaging and self-hosted environments
description: Claude Code sessions can now message each other on macOS and Linux, enabling Claude to pass findings between sessions. Self-hosted runner support launched in public beta for Team/Enterprise plans, allowing organizations to run Claude Code cloud sessions on their own infrastructure.

title: Cloud Agents start 3x faster with Builds
description: Cursor introduced 'builds'—ready-to-use development environments prepared in the background. Agents boot 10x faster with 3x faster time to first token. Build history dashboard allows inspection of build status, logs, and commit SHAs.

community_feedback.quote: Cloud Agents already intelligently manage worktrees to prevent conflicts
Using Cloud Agents for keeping multiple streams running simultaneously with computer use features for testing

title: Google Workspace plugins
description: New plugins provide direct access to Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar. Users can search, create, organize files, manage emails, and handle calendar events directly from Cursor.

title: Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash models available
description: New AI models Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash added to GitHub Copilot, expanding model options for different use cases and performance requirements.

title: Copilot CLI v1.0.80 with model configuration updates
description: GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.80 released with updated model configurations, enterprise policy support, and improved sandbox settings transparency.

title: Agent Plugins 1.0 released
description: Agent Plugins 1.0 now available for VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app, enabling extensible plugin architecture for Copilot agents.

community_feedback.quote: Agent Mode is capable of iterating on its own code, recognizing errors, and fixing them
Very impressed with how natural and smooth the experience feels
Agent Mode goes beyond snippet suggestions to help navigate larger code structures and assist with debugging
Improvements between model generations are gradual rather than showing a step function of improvement

title: Copilot Memory and Ollama support for JetBrains
description: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now includes Copilot Memory for context retention and Ollama support for local model inference.

community_feedback.quote: IDE crashes in the 2026.1 beta release track after the Copilot plugin was loaded, causing the IDE to freeze when opening projects

title: Per-model token breakdown in usage reports
description: Enhanced usage reporting now provides detailed token usage breakdown by model, helping teams track and optimize their Copilot usage across different AI models.

title: Copilot on web expands conversation controls
description: GitHub Copilot on the web now features expanded conversation controls including minimize-and-resume support and quicker access to recent chats.

title: Copilot CLI v1.0.79 with enterprise policy support
description: Version 1.0.79 adds enterprise allow-auto-only policy enforcement, proxy URL configuration with user-controlled credentials, model picker improvements, and tgrep for faster large codebase searching.

title: Weekly releases - App, CLI, and VS Code improvements
description: GitHub Copilot App now shows which model handled each request with AI credit details. Copilot CLI adds Sessions sidebar, experimental /worktree command, and /rewind without Git. VS Code 1.132 includes integrated browser with element-level feedback and /btw side questions.

title: Devin Desktop v3.7.25 - Performance and authentication fixes
description: Faster sidebar for users with thousands of cached sessions, filtering now only processes displayed sessions. Fixed authentication issues with self-hosted GitLab servers and older Atlassian MCP instances.

title: Devin Desktop v3.7.16 - UI improvements and sharing
description: Added confirmation for 'Restart to Update' when local agents are working. Settings and Keyboard Shortcuts open as editor tabs by default. Visual polish for Agent Command Center. Devin Local conversations can be shared via sanitized transcript upload. Customizations panel adds search and Subagents section.

community_feedback.quote: RIP Windsurf - Windsurf was a coolish brand, one I could get behind, Devin seems like anything but that
Adieu Windsurf (now Devin), it's been a good run. Been using Windsurf since Aug 2025
The migration somehow uninstalls WS instead of replacing it with Devin

title: Devin Desktop v3.6.27 - Windows certificate store support
description: Windows version now loads root and intermediate certificates from Windows certificate store, fixing sign-in failures with self-signed certificates. Edit tools now refuse to write through symlinks for security.

title: v0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter. Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Preview model added. /clear command now provides confirmation message. OpenRouter MoonshotAI Kimi K2 model support. Model announcements display with no-arg /model command.

title: Computer History for macOS
description: Feature in macOS desktop app that converts activity across applications and websites into memories and timeline that ChatGPT and Codex can use. Users can control which apps and websites contribute, pause collection, and review or delete history. Limited to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users.

title: Agent Import functionality and Linux Desktop Preview
description: Support for importing from Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Cursor including instructions, settings, skills, plugins, projects, and recent work. ChatGPT desktop app for Linux available for Ubuntu, Debian, and Fedora on x64 and ARM64 processors.

title: Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red security tiers
description: Two access tiers for approved defenders in security work. Daybreak Blue for defensive security work with GPT-5.6 Sol model. Daybreak Red for authorized vulnerability reproduction and red teaming with GPT-5.6 Cyber model. Both require approval through Trusted Access for Cyber.

title: v0.147.0 - Agent Plugins and conversation organization
description: Install portable Agent Plugins and search across local, personal, workspace, and remote plugin catalogs. Organize conversations into persistent, manually ordered sections. New --approve-for-me flag for automatically reviewed approvals. Import from Cursor-managed skills. Support for opt-in MCP 2026-07-28 protocol with paginated discovery.

community_feedback.quote: Codex CLI has the largest open MCP plugin ecosystem with 9,000+ servers, plus 90+ proprietary Codex plugins
Codex CLI is the only lab agent that's open source, OS-sandboxed, and local-model-capable all at once
The Codex app feels like the missing IDE layer for the Codex CLI with features like one-click Xcode integration, diff reviews, and agent management

title: v0.54.0 - PR Automation and security enhancements
description: Integrated Antigravity agent runner with dual-locking Firestore concurrency controls for PR generator. Enhanced caretaker triage to post comments prior to auto-closing issues. Prevented cleartext credential leakage by enforcing HTTPS, rotated session IDs on model fallbacks, and skipped merged function-response turns.
